Badenoch: "This Chogm summit is yet another opportunity for people to start asking Britain for money because of the slave trade." "We need to start looking at how we can bring the Commonwealth together – start looking forwards, not backwards. I don't think we should be giving any money to compensate people for the slave trade, and I don't think that Andy Burnham needs to be apologising because it is a lever to wedge open the door to ask for cash."
Antigua's Prime Minister told ITV News it was "no wonder" Badenoch was not Prime Minister, and repeated desire for Antigua to become a republic.
